**Note:** If you are a peer reviewer or researcher, you may also contact the corresponding author directly via email (see `README.md`).

### Issue Category
- [ ] Data / `extracted_models.json` inconsistency
- [ ] PRISMA checklist / Protocol clarification
- [ ] Typo in supplementary tables or documentation
- [ ] Citation / Bibliography issue
- [ ] Other

### Description
Provide a clear and concise description of the issue or inquiry.

### Context / Location
Indicate the specific file, table, or section (e.g., `results/tables/study_detail_table.tex` or `data/extracted_models.json`).

### Additional Context
Add any other context, screenshots, or code snippets about the issue here.
